BiblicalUsage: Beth-Emek means house of the valley, and it is named once, on the border of Asher in Joshua 19:27, where the boundary turns toward the sunrising and reaches Zebulun and the valley of Jiphthah-el. A border town, known only by where the line ran.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the borders God set for his people were exact, and a valley town counted as much as a capital.
